deadline_text_verbatim: Fall Early Action — Application Deadline: November 1
limitations: YEAR-LESS. Every deadline on Wisconsin's own deadlines page is a bare day-and-month. deadline_date is null and no year has been synthesised. Note the internal contrast: on the same site the test-optional policy page names its cycles precisely ('Spring 2027, Fall 2027, and Spring 2028', REQ-9501) while the deadlines page names none - so this is a page-level editorial choice, not an institution that avoids stating years. The page states 'Early Action is non-binding.'
cycle_note: Not derivable from the page. UW-Madison's own statement that first-year applications open August 1 makes the recurring pattern clear but supplies no year for any individual deadline.

deadline_text_verbatim: Fall Early Action — Materials Deadline: November 9
limitations: Year-less. A SECOND deadline eight days after the application deadline, for supporting materials - the two-stage shape seen at METU and CAO, here made explicit as its own column. A deadline engine that surfaces only the application date tells a student they are done when they are not.

deadline_text_verbatim: Spring Regular Decision — Application Deadline: October 1
limitations: Year-less. Spring entry is a genuinely separate intake, not a late round of the Fall cycle - it has its own application, materials and decision dates. ORYN's deadline model assumes one annual cycle per institution and would collapse the two.
